item.title: Overgrown trees impacting signalling, 10th August
item.description:
At the end of Arle Road, Cheltenham, where there is a crossroads between Gloucester Road and Millbrook Street, the traffic lights facing onto Arle Road are nearly entirely covered by the tree branches pictured in the photographs. As well as it obstructing visibility of the traffic light signals, it is also impacting the traffic sensor on the lights. It appears to be allowing a fraction of the road traffic on this side compared to when the tree wasn't as overgrown. Can this tree be cut back to resolve the issue?

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 10-30, Millbrook Street, Wymans Brook, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Overgrown hedges hiding ‘caution entrances sign’ and uncut verges intruding on highway, 10th August
item.description:
All along this top section of Harp Hill as you round the bend to the new Battledown Mews estate’s temporary entrance, the verges are very overgrown with the sign warning drivers to use caution now completely obscured between Sovereign View and The Oaks. Please can this be dealt with as it means cars approach in the middle of the road steering away from the overgrown verges.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Harp Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
